newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy police arrest 17 in alleged paedophilia ring.
newsitem.headline: Italy police arrest 17 in alleged paedophilia ring.

text.p: Italian police arrested 17 people on Tuesday on suspicion of running a ring that produced pornographic videos of children, state prosecutors said.
They said the accused were being held in preventative detention on suspicion of raping and assaulting 19 children aged between six and nine in Torre Annunziata, near the southern city of Naples.
They were also suspected of drugging and chaining up the children while using them to make pornographic videos.

"The children were subjected to violence on the premises of an elementary school and then in apartments...where filming took place and photographs were taken," prosecutor Alfredo Ormanni told reporters.

Among the accused were the caretaker of the school, who was suspected of helping to lure the children away during recreation time with promises of pocket money, and several women, judicial sources said. The detainees were not named.
Investigations into the ring began more than a year ago after the mother of one of the children went to the police.

French authorities have placed over 300 people under investigation and remanded more than 20 in custody in the last few days in a nationwide investigation into the selling of pornographic video cassettes involving under-age boys.
